question: Who founded the Bahmani kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alauddin Bahman Shah (alias Hasan Gangu).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bahmani kingdom** was founded by **Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah** (alias Hasan Gangu) in **1347. **
 
• His original name was Zafar Khan titled** "Alauddin Bahman Shah Sultan – Founder of the Bahmani Dynasty"** with his capital at **Gulbarga **and all his coins were minted at **Hasanabad**.
 
• It was the **first independent Muslim kingdom **of the** Deccan** in South India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Firuzshah Bahmani -** Firuz Shah Bahmani also known as Taj ud-Din Firuz Shah, was the ruler of the Bahmani Sultanate from** 1397 to 1422.**
 
• **Mohammad bin Tughlaq **- He was the eldest son of Ghiyas-ud-Din-Tughlaq, the founder of the Tughlaq dynasty. 
 
• **Mir Zafar -** Syed Mir Jafar Ali Khan Bahadur was a military general who became the first dependent Nawab of Bengal of the British East India Company.
